_doc: Large batch L02 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

sloth-bear/f:u1.note: Shaggy Charge: a bear charge is a body slam, not an electric zig; quick tag kept for speed

sloth-bear/f:b1.note: Sloth Hoover: sucking termites up the snout reads as a gulp; also breaks the four-slash run of this bear

glacier-bear/f:u2.note: Glacier Roar: no tag, no keyword; a roar is a booming shock wave, ripple rings. Best guess

crab-eating-raccoon/f:u1.note: Shell Crack: cracking a shell is a smash, not a zig; quick tag kept for speed

crab-eating-raccoon/f:u3.note: Wash Off: wet fur shaken out in water rings (evade beaten by the wash picture)

beaver-foreman/f:u0.note: Tail Slap: a flat tail slap is a thump, not a slash

beaver-foreman/f:u2.note: Gnaw Through: the art is teeth on wood; art beats the pierce tag (as Fire Sting)
